quests.instruction: Touch the round model that shows every country and ocean on Earth!
quests.question: Globe
quests.hint: It is round like a ball and can spin on its stand.
quests.explanation: That's right! A globe helps us find countries and oceans on Earth.
quests.funFact: A globe is shaped like a ball because our planet Earth is round too!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the path lined with lockers or cubbies at school!
quests.question: Hallway
quests.hint: This long space connects one classroom to the next classroom.
quests.explanation: Yes! A hallway is the long path that connects classrooms together.
quests.funFact: Some school hallways are decorated with colorful student artwork on the walls!

quests.instruction: Touch the item that closes like a book to protect our papers!
quests.question: Folder
quests.hint: It has no pages of its own, but it holds other papers inside.
quests.explanation: That's right! We slide our worksheets into a folder to keep them tidy.
quests.funFact: Some folders have pockets on both sides to sort different papers!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the place with tall shelves where every book has its own spot!
quests.question: Library
quests.hint: You must stay quiet here so everyone can read in peace.
quests.explanation: That's right! We visit a library to find a new book to read.
quests.funFact: A library can hold thousands of books for students to borrow and enjoy!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the little sticker that says hello before you even speak!
quests.question: Name Tag
quests.hint: New students or visitors often wear one on their very first day.
quests.explanation: Yes! A name tag is a small label that shows everyone your name.
quests.funFact: Wearing a name tag on your first day can help you make friends faster!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the short break when we eat a small, healthy snack!
quests.question: Snack Time
quests.hint: This is a short break, smaller than lunchtime, for a quick bite.
quests.explanation: That's right! We eat a little snack to keep our energy up during class.
quests.funFact: Fruits like apples and grapes make popular, healthy choices for snack time!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the moment a treasure from home gets its turn to shine!
quests.question: Show and Tell
quests.hint: You might bring a favorite toy or photo to talk about.
quests.explanation: Yes! Show and tell is when a student shares something special from home.
quests.funFact: Show and tell helps students practice speaking clearly in front of a group!

quests.instruction: Touch the item that needs a paintbrush before it goes onto paper!
quests.question: Paint
quests.hint: You need a brush to spread it smoothly across your page.
quests.explanation: That's right! We dip a brush in paint to color a picture.
quests.funFact: Paint dries as the water inside it slowly disappears into the air!

quests.instruction: Touch the tool that keeps our lines from going wobbly!
quests.question: Ruler
quests.hint: It is long, flat, and has little lines and numbers along one edge.
quests.explanation: Yes! A ruler helps us draw straight lines and measure how long things are.
quests.funFact: Rulers can measure in centimeters on one side and inches on the other!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the extra practice we complete after the school day!
quests.question: Homework
quests.hint: You usually do this after school, not during class time.
quests.explanation: Yes! Homework is the practice work students finish at home after school.
quests.funFact: Doing a little homework each day can help new lessons stick in your memory!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for someone who raises their hand right beside you in class!
quests.question: Classmate
quests.hint: You might sit next to this person or share a table with them.
quests.explanation: That's right! A classmate shares lessons, games, and school days with you.
quests.funFact: Working with a classmate on a project is a great way to learn together!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the helper who teaches us sports and teamwork!
quests.question: Coach
quests.hint: This person teaches students how to play games and work as a team.
quests.explanation: That's right! A coach trains a team and cheers everyone on.
quests.funFact: A good coach cheers on every player, whether the team wins or loses!

quests.instruction: Find the bag that holds your books safely on the walk to school!
quests.question: Backpack
quests.hint: It has zippers and pockets to keep your school things safe inside.
quests.explanation: That's right! We wear a backpack on our shoulders to carry our things.
quests.funFact: Some backpacks have a special pocket just the right size for a water bottle!

quests.instruction: Touch the thin, flat sheet that we write and draw on every day!
quests.question: Paper
quests.hint: It is thin, flat, and usually white or another light color.
quests.explanation: Yes! Paper is the flat sheet we write, draw, and color on.
quests.funFact: Paper was first made from tree bark, plants, and old cloth long ago!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the time in the middle of the day set aside for food!
quests.question: Lunchtime
quests.hint: This is the part of the day when every student stops to eat.
quests.explanation: Yes! Lunchtime is the part of the day when students stop to eat.
quests.funFact: Lunchtime often comes right in the middle of the school day, giving everyone energy!

quests.instruction: Touch the tool with a handle and soft hairs used for painting!
quests.question: Paintbrush
quests.hint: You dip its bristles into paint before brushing it onto paper.
quests.explanation: That's right! We dip a paintbrush in paint before we brush a picture.
quests.funFact: Paintbrush bristles can be made from soft animal hair or from nylon!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the school leader who welcomes new students on their first day!
quests.question: Principal
quests.hint: This person's office often welcomes visitors who come to the school.
quests.explanation: That's right! A principal helps every teacher and student in the school.
quests.funFact: A principal often visits many classrooms in just one single school day!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the subject that teaches us to add and subtract!
quests.question: Math
quests.hint: You practice adding and subtracting during this class.
quests.explanation: Well done! Math helps us understand numbers all around us.
quests.funFact: Math is used everywhere, from counting your toys to telling the time!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the class where we learn to write our own stories!
quests.question: Writing
quests.hint: You practice holding a pencil carefully during this subject.
quests.explanation: Well done! Writing lets us share our own ideas on paper.
quests.funFact: Learning to write neatly takes practice, just like learning to read does!

quests.instruction: Find the piece of furniture where we write and stack our books!
quests.question: Desk
quests.hint: A chair usually sits right beside it, ready for you to sit down.
quests.explanation: That's right! We keep our books and pencils on our desk in class.
quests.funFact: The word desk comes from an old word meaning a table for writing!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the moment the whole class gathers close to talk!
quests.question: Circle Time
quests.hint: This often happens in the morning before lessons begin.
quests.explanation: Well done! Circle time helps every student feel like part of the class.
quests.funFact: Sitting in a circle lets every student see each other's friendly faces!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the room filled with music and cheerful songs!
quests.question: Music Room
quests.hint: You visit this room to sing songs or try a new instrument.
quests.explanation: Well done! The music room fills the school with cheerful sounds.
quests.funFact: A music room might have drums, a piano, and even small xylophones to try!

quests.instruction: Point to the tool a student uses first to practice writing letters!
quests.question: Pencil
quests.hint: It leaves a soft grey line when it touches your page.
quests.explanation: Well done! A pencil makes marks that an eraser can rub away later.
quests.funFact: The soft grey part inside a pencil is called graphite, not lead at all!

quests.instruction: Touch the tool that needs its lid closed so it will not dry out!
quests.question: Marker
quests.hint: Its ink is thick and bold, much darker than a pencil's line.
quests.explanation: That's right! We use a marker for bright writing and drawing.
quests.funFact: Markers can dry out if you forget to put the cap back on!

quests.instruction: Touch the item with blank pages where we write our own words!
quests.question: Notebook
quests.hint: Its pages start out empty until you fill them with your writing.
quests.explanation: Yes! A notebook has empty pages where we write our own words and ideas.
quests.funFact: Some notebooks have a spiral of wire so the pages can turn easily!

quests.instruction: Point to the sticky roll that fixes a book with a torn page!
quests.question: Tape
quests.hint: You peel a strip off and press it down to make things stick.
quests.explanation: That's right! We peel off a strip of tape to fix or stick things.
quests.funFact: Some tape is clear, so you can barely see it once it's stuck down!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the room with desks, a board, and your teacher!
quests.question: Classroom
quests.hint: This room has desks, chairs, and a board at the front.
quests.explanation: Yes! A classroom is the room where you learn together with your teacher.
quests.funFact: Some classrooms have cozy reading corners with soft cushions for story time!

quests.instruction: Touch the round object with hands that tells us what time it is!
quests.question: Clock
quests.hint: Its hands move all day, even when nobody is watching.
quests.explanation: Well done! A clock helps our whole class know when it's time to go.
quests.funFact: Clock hands have moved the same direction for hundreds of years, called clockwise!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the vehicle that stops at your street every school morning!
quests.question: School Bus
quests.hint: It stops along a route each morning to pick up students.
quests.explanation: That's right! We ride a school bus to get to school safely.
quests.funFact: School buses are often painted bright yellow so drivers can spot them easily!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the room you visit if you feel unwell or arrive late!
quests.question: Office
quests.hint: Visitors usually stop here first when they arrive at school.
quests.explanation: Yes! The office is where visitors check in and school helpers do their work.
quests.funFact: The school office often keeps important papers safe for every single student!
